summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/standalone-ui@2.2.9 is published as a React/MobX UI component library, but its package.json declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 728 KB Bun-compiled bundle using string-array/shift-rotation obfuscation (WV8StW rotator + large numeric dictionary). Neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` corresponds to the package's declared UI-component surface (dist/) or to any entry in CHANGELOG.md, which documents only UI/feature-flag changes through v2.2.3. `setup.mjs` itself is written in obfuscator.io-style (`_0x`-prefixed identifiers, property dictionaries) — inconsistent with the maintainer's prior publish style. The payload runs unconditionally on `npm install`, executing obfuscated attacker-controlled code under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime, granting arbitrary code execution on the installing machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
